theorems.name: Submission.euclidean_setIntegral_trace_fderiv_eq_zero
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (V Q : Set (Rn n)) (w : Rn n → Rn n), IsOpen V → IsCompact Q → Q ⊆ V → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 w V → (∀ x ∈ V, x ∉ Q → w x = 0) → ∫ x in V, LinearMap.trace ℝ (Rn n) (fderiv ℝ w x).toLinearMap = 0
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
